weight_description: Sum of all 14 GGUF tensor payloads, including the 256000-byte d2t mapping; mostly BF16 with F32 norms. Approximation of GPU weight allocation under full offload; excludes file metadata and allocator padding, and may include small CPU-resident tensors. Shared target embeddings are not counted again.
assumptions: Current local GGUF and launch-script defaults represent this benchmark: full GPU offload, one sequence, FP16 draft K/V, 8192 context tokens. Historical logs confirm target context but do not expose every allocation or environment override. KV is allocated capacity, not just occupied tokens.
